card_grid.anchor: after:Where a multi-location program leaks money
card_grid.note: Audit each one before the next budget cycle closes.

cards.title: The local reorder
cards.text: A site that orders on its own account pays the premium the program exists to remove.

cards.title: The duplicate SKU
cards.text: Two products doing one job means two par levels, two storage slots and more cash on shelves.

cards.title: The mismatched dispenser
cards.text: A refill that does not fit the site's hardware becomes a special order, then an emergency order.

cards.title: The invisible usage rate
cards.text: Without a per-site consumption number, par levels get set from memory and drift within a quarter.

cards.title: The unmeasured cadence
cards.text: A delivery cycle nobody tracks quietly becomes reactive buying again.
